title: Hangman & the Elite: losing faith, finding a family
summary: Adam Page struggles with failure and fractured friendships before challenging former partner Kenny Omega for AEW’s top prize.

chapters.title: Hangman falls short
chapters.result: Chris Jericho defeats Page to become the first AEW World Champion.
chapters.context: The failed title bid anchors Page’s crisis of confidence.

chapters.title: Partners face their friends
chapters.result: Page and Omega retain the tag titles against the Young Bucks.
chapters.context: Success as a team does not repair Page’s relationship with the Bucks.

chapters.title: The partnership breaks down
chapters.result: FTR defeat Page and Omega for the tag titles.
chapters.context: Losing the championships accelerates the split between the partners.

chapters.title: Omega wins their singles showdown
chapters.result: Omega beats Page in the world-title eliminator final.
chapters.context: Page watches his former partner move ahead in the title chase.

chapters.title: Hangman finally wins
chapters.result: Page defeats Omega for the AEW World Championship.
chapters.context: The Dark Order join Page to celebrate the payoff to his long pursuit.
